description: The constructor an `instanceof` consults is the declared one: a closure writes `Hostile` into the `let` the guard narrowed to `Plain`, and the checker keeps that narrowing across the write, so the check meets the `[Symbol.hasInstance]` the declaration really admits. The `const` stays clean, since nothing can write one.

diagnostics.message: Checking `value instanceof constructor` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it runs the method `[Symbol.hasInstance]`, whose body was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge it with `try`/`catch`, or make the method `[Symbol.hasInstance]` non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
